def find_polynomial_degree_and_next_value():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    sequence = list(map(int, data[1:]))

    def calculate_differences(seq):
        diff = [seq[i] - seq[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(seq))]
        return diff

    def find_degree_of_difference(diffs):
        prev_diffs = diffs[:]
        while True:
            current_diffs = calculate_differences(prev_diffs)
            if all(val == current_diffs[0] for val in current_diffs):
                break
            prev_diffs = current_diffs
        return len(prev_diffs)

    degree = find_degree_of_difference(sequence)
    next_value = sequence[-1]
    step = sequence[1] - sequence[0]
    increment = step ** degree

    for _ in range(degree):
        next_value += increment
        step *= degree - _
        increment //= degree

    print(f"{degree} {next_value}")
